edits.text: Confidential Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release
RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and disputes between them arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action.

1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of [INSERT AMOUNT] within [INSERT TIME PERIOD] days after the Effective Date, by [INSERT PAYMENT METHOD], subject to any applicable withholding required by law.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and insurers from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, or obligations of any kind, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action. Defendant shall provide a reciprocal release of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and insurers from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, or obligations of any kind, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that each party may disclose the settlement and its terms to: (a) its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, and other professional advisors who have a need to know and are informed of this confidentiality obligation; and (b) to the extent required by applicable law, regulation, court order, subpoena, or other compulsory legal process, provided that, where legally permitted, the disclosing party gives prompt notice to the other party and reasonably cooperates with any effort to seek confidential treatment.
4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party.
